messages:
lee-quant: Quick follow-up from the RFC thread ":thinking:". Wanted to sketch a lightweight runtime model: map precision profiles into a 2x2 quality vs latency quadrant so runtime can pick the best fit automatically. Two asks: 1) agree API surface (precision_hint + ordered profiles), 2) define minimal telemetry for regressions.
sara-ml: Love the quadrant framing. We need per-request quality_delta and latency histogram (p50/p95). Also note different thresholds for chat vs embeddings.
mike-runtime: Minimal API proposal: optional precision_hint: ["fp8","int8","4bit"] on the request. Deployment config has ordered profiles. Runtime picks first compatible. Example config: ```{
"profiles": ["fp8_low_latency", "int8_balanced", "4bit_high_compact"],
"precision_hint": ["fp8", "int8"]
}```
priya-ops: Private/Dedicated note: some profiles require vendor drivers (Ampere FP8 kernels). Add an opt-out flag for air-gapped installs and document driver_dependency.
carla-qa: How to gate quality? Small canary harness with N prompts + metric threshold. Store harness_id in profile so canary picks right tests. If quality_regression > threshold -> rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary started: d-773 (profiles: fp8_low_latency -> int8_balanced). Will auto-fallback to int8_balanced on errors or if latency > SLO.
nana-ml: INT8 needs per-layer scale calibration. Profiles must reference calibration_id + artifact_checksum so runtime can verify calibration blob matches profile.
lee-quant: Proposed minimal profile schema (flat): name, precision, kernel_tags, calibration_id(opt), expected_latency_p95, quality_harness_id, fallback_order, strict_profile(bool opt). Runtime MUST emit precision_chosen and reason (compatibility/fallback/quality).
mike-runtime: Telemetry contract: samples_evaluated, quality_metric (e.g., embedding_dist / rouge), quality_delta, latency_p50, latency_p95, fallback_reason, profile_checksum. Emit per-canary and aggregate.
carla-qa: We'll add harnesses and nightly regression job comparing profiles to baseline. Also recommend storing the last_good_profile_checksum.
priya-ops: Add strict_profile flag for Dedicated/Private so runtime refuses automatic fallback unless explicit rollout. Helpful for compliance.
nana-ml: Also include economics note: map cost_delta per 1% quality loss to help automated decisioning.
lee-quant: Consensus seems achievable: quadrant mapping + precision_hint + ordered profiles + minimal telemetry + profile artifacts (calibration_id + checksum) + strict_profile toggle. I'll draft an RFC appendix with sample configs, telemetry schema, and recommended thresholds for chat/summarization/embeddings. Add kernel capability negotiation section? Ping me and I will include. :thumbsup:
